summary.en: GPU timing, one-cycle device diagnostics, and canvas sizing helpers.
summary.zh: GPU 计时、单次设备生命周期诊断和画布尺寸助手。

description.en: Measure GPU timestamp elapsed time surrounding work submitted by a callback.
description.zh: 测量回调提交工作前后的 GPU 时间戳间隔。

description.en: Callback receiving the shared context. Submit the work to ctx.device.queue before the callback returns/resolves; encoding without submission is not measured.
description.zh: 接收共享上下文的回调。回调返回或完成前应把工作提交至 ctx.device.queue；只编码而未提交的工作不会被计入。

description.en: Callback argument: the current shared GPU context, including its device.
description.zh: 回调参数：当前共享 GPU 上下文及其 device。

description.en: GPU timestamp difference in milliseconds, including gaps and queue work between the two marker submissions.
description.zh: 两个标记提交之间的 GPU 时间戳差，单位毫秒，包含中间空隙和队列工作。

constraints.en: Uses three queue phases: submit a leading timestamp, await fn(ctx), then submit a trailing timestamp plus query readback. This is not isolated per-dispatch duration or display FPS.
constraints.zh: 使用三阶段队列：提交前置时间戳，await fn(ctx)，然后提交后置时间戳和查询读回。它不是单独 dispatch 的耗时，也不是显示帧率。

constraints.en: The active device must have timestamp-query enabled. An externally adopted device must have requested the feature itself. Work on another device/queue is outside the markers.
constraints.zh: 当前 device 必须已启用 timestamp-query；外部接入的 device 应自行请求该特性。其他设备/队列的工作不在标记范围内。

constraints.en: Successful measurement destroys temporary query/readback resources. Version 2.0.0 has no finally cleanup if the callback or readback fails.
constraints.zh: 成功测量后会销毁临时查询/读回资源。2.0.0 在回调或读回失败时没有 finally 清理。

errors.en: Rejects UsageError with code ERR_TIMESTAMP_UNSUPPORTED when the device lacks timestamp-query. Context/device, callback, query, and mapping failures propagate.
errors.zh: device 不含 timestamp-query 时拒绝，错误为 UsageError，code 是 ERR_TIMESTAMP_UNSUPPORTED；上下文/设备、回调、查询和映射错误直接传播。

caption.en: Time a prepared kernel submission; kernel/resources are application-owned.
caption.zh: 测量已准备 kernel 的提交；kernel/resources 由应用创建。

exports.name: watchDevice
exports.signature: watchDevice(opts: { onError?: (message: string, recoverable: boolean) => void; onRebuild?: (ctx: GpuContext) => void; }): void

description.en: Observe uncaptured errors and one device-loss/reacquisition cycle.
description.zh: 监听未捕获错误，以及一次设备丢失/重新获取过程。

parameters.name: opts
parameters.type: { onError?: (message: string, recoverable: boolean) => void; onRebuild?: (ctx: GpuContext) => void }

description.en: Callback options; pass {} if no callbacks are needed.
description.zh: 回调选项，无需回调时传 {}。

description.en: Called for uncapturederror with recoverable=true and for device loss with recoverable=false. These flags are library labels, not a guarantee of recovery.
description.zh: uncapturederror 时以 recoverable=true 调用，设备丢失时以 false 调用。这是库的分类标记，并不保证可恢复。

description.en: Error message, or GPU device lost: followed by the loss reason.
description.zh: 错误消息；设备丢失时为 GPU device lost: 加丢失原因。

description.en: True for uncaptured errors; false for device loss.
description.zh: 未捕获错误为 true；设备丢失为 false。

description.en: Called after resetting the shared context and successfully acquiring a fresh device; rebuild your own resources here.
description.zh: 重置共享上下文并成功获取新设备后调用；在此重建应用自己的资源。

description.en: Freshly acquired context, not a repaired version of old buffers or pipelines.
description.zh: 新获取的上下文；旧缓冲和管线不会因此自动修复。

constraints.en: Returns immediately; setup runs asynchronously. No promise, unsubscribe function, or automatic recursive watcher registration is returned.
constraints.zh: 立即返回，注册异步进行；不返回 Promise、取消订阅函数，也不会自动给后继设备重新注册监听。

constraints.en: Only the originally acquired device is watched. Re-register for a new device if needed. Existing simulations, canvases, buffers, and pipelines must be recreated by the application.
constraints.zh: 仅监听最初获取的设备。需要时对新设备重新注册。已有模拟、画布、缓冲和管线均须由应用重新创建。

constraints.en: Reacquisition failure is swallowed. Initial context acquisition has no catch; handle availability before registering. Repeated calls add repeated listeners.
constraints.zh: 重新获取失败会被吞掉；初始上下文获取没有 catch，注册前应处理可用性。重复调用会重复添加监听器。

caption.en: Register diagnostics after verifying context availability.
caption.zh: 验证上下文可用后注册诊断。

description.en: Return the browser preferred canvas texture format.
description.zh: 返回浏览器推荐的画布纹理格式。

constraints.en: Direct browser helper; it does not request a device, configure a canvas, or guard missing navigator.gpu.
constraints.zh: 直接调用浏览器接口，不申请设备、不配置画布，也不检查 navigator.gpu 是否存在。

examples.code:
import { preferredCanvasFormat } from 'wgpu-kit/observe';
const format = preferredCanvasFormat();

caption.en: Read the format before configuring a WebGPU canvas.
caption.zh: 配置 WebGPU 画布前读取格式。

description.en: Update canvas backing dimensions from CSS client size and capped device pixel ratio.
description.zh: 根据 CSS 客户区尺寸和有上限的设备像素比更新画布像素尺寸。

description.en: Canvas whose width and height backing attributes will be changed; CSS dimensions remain unchanged.
description.zh: 修改该画布的 width/height 像素属性，CSS 尺寸保持不变。

description.en: Maximum device pixel ratio; effective DPR is min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, dprCap). Use a finite positive cap.
description.zh: 设备像素比上限；实际 DPR 为 min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, dprCap)。应使用有限正数。

description.en: True if width or height changed; false if both already match.
description.zh: 宽或高发生变化时为 true；两者都相同时为 false。

constraints.en: Each dimension is max(1, floor(clientDimension × effectiveDPR)). No input validation, ResizeObserver, renderer resize, or texture reallocation is performed for you.
constraints.zh: 每个维度按 max(1, floor(clientDimension × effectiveDPR)) 计算。不执行输入校验，不自动创建 ResizeObserver，也不替你调整渲染器或重建纹理。

caption.zh: 在应用尺寸变化处理逻辑中调用。
